name: tikiapi
description: Images, video and sound through TikiAPI: generation with live prices, consistent characters and locations, a Seedance director, motion transfer, story bibles, launch videos, ad videos from script to cut, ad scripts, audience tests and colour looks.

interface.shortDescription: Generate images and video, direct scenes, and make ads end to end
interface.longDescription: TikiAPI skills turn Codex into a small video studio. Generate images, clips, music and sound with Seedance, Nano Banana, GPT Image, Seedream and more at live prices; keep a person and a place consistent across shots; turn a scene into a director's shot breakdown and a block-by-block Seedance prompt; move a reference video's motion onto your character; write a story bible as a skill for a whole series; make a launch video of a project or a website; write and test ad scripts on simulated viewers; make a full vertical ad from script to finished cut; and match a colour look. Calls the TikiAPI MCP server or REST API with the key from TIKIAPI_KEY, reads limits and prices from the live model list, prices every paid step before ordering it, and returns links.
defaultPrompt: Make a 9:16 product photo of this bottle with TikiAPI
Turn this scene into a Seedance shot breakdown and prompt
Make a 20-second launch video of this project
Make a vertical ad video for my product, script to final cut
Create a character I can reuse in every shot
